arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. O'Donnell addressed the vessel negligence theory. He noted Justice O'Connor's inquiry about its procedural history.
Mr. Ferrini raised points regarding the new maritime law. Mr. O'Donnell responded to these specific legal arguments.
Chief Justice Rehnquist concluded the oral argument. The case is now submitted for decision.
